integrity: Analytical argument and finite reproducible tests; earlier reversible heatbath and Ising transfer-matrix results explicitly recognized.
scientific_limitations: The classification requires independent synchronous updates, cyclic N>=3, and 0<p,r<1; it does not address deterministic boundaries, infinite volume, or stationary measures off p=1/2. Finite tests cannot prove the universal theorem, and priority to general reversible-PCA treatments remains provisional.
title: A sharp reversible line and odd–even correlation law for a two-parameter probabilistic cellular automaton
